description:
Who owns a stock, from SEC Form 13F filings by investment managers (hedge funds, mutual funds, banks, pensions
with $100M+): number of institutional holders, share of the company they hold, top holders with their stake and
quarter-over-quarter change, and how many funds opened, added, cut or sold out. Analyst and Edge also get the
lists of new funds, sold-out funds, biggest adds and biggest cuts. Use for 'who owns PLTR?', 'are funds buying or
selling NVDA?', 'top institutional holders', 'did hedge funds add last quarter?'.
